text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, on my way back to my office...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Hey, hear me out for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm a simp for everyone, not just my
squad! But
it's not like I can vibe with
everyone whenever I
want!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know they're just as down bad
for me,
but all these hangout invites got
me cooked!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what's the matter? I'm right
here if you
need someone to talk to.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oooh... Bestiiie! I need to raaant!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oooh okay, so you have too many
friends you
wanna hang out with, and
not enough time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Straight facts! Like, I wuv all my friends!
And I
have lots of fun chatting with you,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There you are. It's time for our run,
Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
See?! I wanna hang out with Nature too!
I'm
bummed, no cap!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm not here to hang out, we're
supposed to
be partner running.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Helios! Hiya! I'm gonna do some
bargain
hunting. Wanna come?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet! But I gotta race with Nature! And
chat up
Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This high-key suuuucks! What do I
doooo?!
Heeelp!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
OH! For real! We should all just have a
party
together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... How about the dorm kitchen?
It can fit
lots of people, and we don't
gotta worry about
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, someone understood the
assignment! That's
a fire idea! A pajama
party!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Now that's giving teen spirit! I'll bring
some
Umastagram-worthy drinks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They organized a party just like that...
Extroverts
really are scary...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Can you bring that dried squid you like, Nature? I just know it'd go viral!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? When did I get reeled into this
party?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be there too! Having a
trainer at the
party would be fire!
WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be there too! Having a
trainer at the
party would be fire!
WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's gooooo! You passed the vibe
check! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And as your rewaaard... You get to be
the party
squad leader! Let's turn this
party into a real
banger!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fuji! We're gonna have a party at
the dorm!
See ya there! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, just a moment. Trainers are not
allowed to
enter the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I end up getting photos of the party
later.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just give up. There's no stopping
Helios
once she's hooked on an idea.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Facts! Never underestimate a party
animal! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! Are you for real?! Wanna
wear my
uniform to get in then?
choice_data_list: いや、トレーナーは寮に入れないから！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's a fun idea, but super obvious.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Boo! That's straight up sucks! But, well,
dem's the
breaks! I'll tag you in the
photos though!
